title: Inspirations and first drum set bought in 1919
summary: He names Henry Martin, Black Benny, Red Happy and Baby Dodds as models, takes press-roll lessons, and buys a first outfit around 1919.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: And, well, he got his inspiration from Bunk. And I got my inspiration from Henry Martin, Black Benny, Red Happy, Baby Dodds. But Baby Dodds used to play in the Orleans during them times. Yeah. Well, after I got old enough I used to go to dances. I, wherever Baby Dodds was playing I was always there. And actually I got a lot from, learned a lot from him. Oh, sure. Yeah. Well, when I, around 1918, I was taking press roll lessons from Henry Martin. Yeah. He was a left-hander like me.

And I used to go and take press rolls and learn the beats and different things. He wasn't learning how to read or anything like that. No. Because he told me it wasn't necessary. Yeah. But anyway, I used to learn the beats and the press rolls from him. And around 1919, I bought my first set of drums. Hmm. I bought them from Woodrisse and direct from the factory. Yeah. In them days, he was using overhanging pedals, side cymbal, Chinese tum-tum, one cymbal, snatched drum, and a drum stand.
That's what your first kid outfit?

That was my first outfit, yeah. Yeah. Well, most of them was made of wood. They wasn't like they are nowadays. Yeah. But the drums they got nowadays, much heavier than you was. It was very light because I used to walk from Iberville and Galvis all the way down to Old Bourbon and Roma somewhere along down and then play music.
Yeah. Was it a very expensive outfit, the first one you had?
No. I think I paid around about a hundred and some odd dollars for the whole outfit.
